title: Worst-case expected comparison cost
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type and let $n$ be a natural number. The maximum expected comparison cost for lists of length $n$ is the supremum of the expected comparison cost over all natural numbers $k$ and all lists $l$ of elements of $\alpha$ whose length is $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $\alpha$ is a type with a linear order
